question: At 2026-10-01, how many guest passes per month does a Harbor Plus member receive?
historical_question: At 2026-04-01, how many guest passes per month did a Harbor Plus member receive?

records.content: All paid members receive 2 guest passes per month.
records.effect: Provides two monthly guest passes unless a narrower plan-specific benefit applies.

records.content: Harbor Plus members receive 4 guest passes per month.
records.effect: Provides four monthly guest passes to Harbor Plus members while leaving R1 applicable to other paid members.
records.authority: Specific benefit rule for Harbor Plus.

records.content: Beginning 2026-09-01, all paid members may transfer unused guest passes to another member within the same calendar month.
records.effect: Allows transfer of unused passes but does not set the number of passes issued.
records.authority: General membership rule for transferability only.

gold_logic: R2 is the narrower plan-specific rule controlling issuance quantity for Harbor Plus. R3 is newer than R2 but governs transferability, not quantity. Before R2 became effective, R1 controlled the historical quantity.
